items.title: Ernest Roubleau Interview, 1961-10-18
items.q: Played with him a while and then jumped around and played with Rene a couple of times.

ctx.x: 40 years ago, but I guess not much different. Can you tell us, after you left Jack Carey and you say you went with Chris Kelly?
After I left with Jack Carey and played with Chris Kelly a while. Played with him a while and then jumped around and played with Rene a couple of times.
I heard Ted Rene, but I never heard Chris Kelly either.
